content.text: I implemented `clamp(value, min, max)` in `src/clamp.mjs` as a named export. It returns `value` limited to the range from `min` to `max`, and it throws a `RangeError` when `min` is greater than `max`. `npm test` passes, but the existing test file has only one test, so the `RangeError` case isn't covered.
